summary.goal: Status bar showing active run progress at a glance. Persistent visibility without taking focus from other work.

acceptance_criteria.description: Progress indicator showing task count (4/7) or percentage
Active agent count with color-coded status dots
Pending gates count with warning indicator
Click status bar to expand full run dashboard
Collapsed state shows minimal info for less intrusion

observations: Click to expand is key interaction
Need to determine which run to show when multiple runs or when viewing a run

priority_order: 1. Currently viewed run (from URL /forge/runs/:id) - highest priority
2. Any run with status='running' - show the running one
3. Most recent run (by started_at) - fallback when nothing is running
active_run_selection.multi_run_indicator: When multiple runs are running but user is viewing one, show '+N running' indicator
active_run_selection.implementation: useActiveRun hook checks URL params first, then queries for running runs

acceptance_criteria.description: Priority 1: If URL is /forge/runs/:id, that run is active
Priority 3: Most recent run by started_at
otherRunningCount: number of other running runs (for multi-run indicator)
SSE subscription for run status changes
Clears activeRun when run completes/fails/cancels (if not viewing that run)

specification.url_integration: Use useParams() from react-router to check current runId

selection_logic.step1: Check if URL has runId param -> use that run
selection_logic.step2: Else fetch running runs -> use first one
selection_logic.step3: Else fetch most recent -> use that
selection_logic.otherRunningCount: runningRuns.length - 1 if activeRun is running, else runningRuns.length
